Schisandra chinensis
Treat hepatitis
Side effects rare, but in large doses it may cause GI
distress or appetite depression. May enhance elimination
of hepatically metabolized drugs. Avoid use in pregnant or 
breast-feeding women.
Reishi; ling zhi
Ganoderma lucidum
Treat hepatitis
Thought to be safe, but safety studies have not been
performed. Occasional side effects include mild digestive
upset, dry mouth, and rash. No known drug interactions.
